Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. Integrate relevant business, market, audience and historical campaign learnings into media recommendations.

Escalate performance deviations, implementation issues or opportunities that require strategic decisions.
Support testing initiatives across audiences, creatives, formats and media tactics.



Measurement & Insights


Track campaign performance against agreed media and marketing KPIs.
Analyze results to understand what worked, what did not and why.
Go beyond media delivery metrics to identify potential connections between media performance and marketing or business outcomes.
Translate campaign results into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
Develop post-campaign analyses and consolidate learnings that can improve future campaigns.
Share relevant learnings across campaigns, markets and business units.

description:
About the job

About the Role

Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. Your knowledge of Mexico's geography, local landmarks, and how people actually navigate your region is something no algorithm can fully replicate. That local intelligence is what makes maps genuinely useful.




Why This Matters

Accurately verified mapping data prevents real-world navigation errors. Your verification work ensures that:

Users can discover trusted businesses and cultural landmarks with confidence
Communities can navigate with accurate, culturally-informed geographic intelligence
Geographic data quality scales across millions of locations and thousands of data variations

At scale, this is infrastructure work. Every verified data point contributes to how billions of people interact with geographic information globally.




What You'll Do

Core Responsibilities

Structured Quality Audits on Spatial Datasets

Conduct detailed, methodical evaluations of geographic and business data entries using advanced mapping platforms and GIS-standard evaluation tools
Assess spatial data points (coordinates, boundaries, locations) for accuracy and consistency across multiple authoritative sources
Verify business information (names, hours, categories, contact details, service offerings) against primary and secondary sources
Evaluate cultural and regional context—ensuring data reflects how Mexicans actually navigate, describe, and interact with their geographic environment




Cross-Reference Complex Data Against Authoritative Sources

Compare business, geographic, and cultural data entries across multiple authoritative sources (official registries, local government databases, business directories, street-level verification)
Identify discrepancies where data conflicts across sources (e.g., conflicting addresses, outdated hours, category misclassifications)
Apply critical thinking to determine which source is most reliable and document reasoning transparently




Rigorous Framework Application

Apply detailed, multi-dimensional evaluation frameworks with consistency and precision across dozens of geographic, business, and cultural data variations
Understand the intent behind evaluation guidelines and apply them contextually—knowing when to follow rules strictly and when to apply judgment




Work Across Diverse Task Types

Quickly learn new task specifications and apply them with the same rigor




Provide Structured Feedback for Algorithm Improvement

Articulate clear, actionable feedback that helps refine mapping algorithms and improve geographic intelligence

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. You'll sit at the intersection of data engineering, business analytics, and growth strategy — working closely with our Director of Analytics and partnering with centralized data science, marketing, product, and GTM teams. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

The Associate Manager, Media will support the development and execution of Mattel's LATAM media strategy, translating brand and business objectives into integrated, audience-led media plans across the consumer journey.

The role combines strategic media planning, audience and data activation, performance marketing, creator-led media, measurement, and agency leadership. The Associate Manager will work across markets and cross-functional teams to maximize the effectiveness of Mattel's media investment while continuously identifying opportunities to improve how data, technology, platforms, and emerging media capabilities drive business results.

What You’ll Do


Develop and execute full-funnel, audience-led media strategies aligned with brand, consumer, and business objectives across LATAM.

Manage media investment, forecasting, pacing, and financial processes, continuously identifying opportunities to improve media effectiveness and efficiency.

Communicate media strategies, performance, learnings, risks, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders while managing multiple markets and workstreams across LATAM.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Economics, Finance, or related field.

Experience managing media agencies and external partners, with the ability to evaluate and challenge strategic recommendations, not only coordinate execution.

Strong project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple brands, markets, campaigns, and stakeholders simultaneously.
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to present media recommendations clearly to non-media audiences.
Advanced English required. Spanish and/or Portuguese capabilities are a plus.


Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Join Mattel's Talent Community and start receiving exciting updates about our company, our employees, and our culture. We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors

description:
About the job

About Kueski

At Kueski, we're dedicated to improving the financial lives of people in Mexico. Since 2012, we've been the leading buy now, pay later (BNPL) and online consumer credit platform in Latin America, known for our innovative financial services. Our flagship product, Kueski Pay, provides seamless payment solutions for both online and in-store transactions, establishing itself as the preferred option for nearly 30% of Mexico's top e-commerce merchants. Notably, we were the first to introduce BNPL on Amazon Mexico.

We're a tech company with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration, and impact, fostering a strong, diverse, and inclusive workplace. Our commitment to excellence and ethical business practices has earned us multiple industry recognitions. In 2024, we were named one of the World’s Top FinTech Companies by CNBC and recognized as one of the most ethical companies in Mexico by AMITAI. Additionally, we were certified as a Best Place to Work for LGBTQ+ Equality by HRC Equidad MX 2025 and ranked among the Best Companies for Female Talent by EFY.

Position

The Growth Team Lead is the owner of Kueski’s active customer growth across Kueski Pay and Kueski Cash. This role pairs senior product leadership with commercial ownership to set and commit to active customer targets and chair a standing cross-functional growth team spanning Lending, Marketing, Branding, CX, Data, Account Management, and Credit Risk.

The Growth Team Lead resolves trade-offs across these functions, prioritizes the growth levers that matter most, and builds the foundational infrastructure — lifecycle marketing, attribution, shared metrics — that determines whether every other growth initiative can succeed.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Commercial Ownership


Own the P&L outcome for Kueski’s active customer growth and report progress against targets to executive leadership.
Set and commit to active customer growth targets, then translate those targets into pillar-level goals owned by named cross-functional leads; paired with leading indicators the team can move within an experiment window.
Prioritize the core growth pillars, including pricing and acceptance, activation, repeat usage and habit formation, churn prediction, and reactivation.


Cross-Functional Growth Leadership


Resolve trade-offs between competing functional goals, such as portfolio growth versus customer or merchant experience.
Lead the cross-functional Growth Team spanning Lending, Marketing, Branding, CX, Data, Account Management, and Risk, driving weekly pillar stand-ups and monthly growth reviews.
Partner with Engineering, Design, and Data to scope and sequence foundational and short-term growth product work, including activation, engagement, and retention features.


Experimentation & Growth Measurement


Direct the fix of foundational growth infrastructure — lifecycle marketing enablement, attribution, and the shared growth dashboard — as a prerequisite for reliable retention and lifecycle programs.


Executive Communication & Strategic Alignment


Build narratives that align cross-functional partners around growth strategy, progress, and results, and represent growth priorities in quarterly leadership reviews.


Experience


7+ years in product management, including ownership of cross-functional or multi-product initiatives at scale.
Proven track record owning a growth or lifecycle P&L, or equivalent commercial accountability, ideally in consumer fintech, or consumer lending business.
Experience leading a cross-functional team and resolving trade-offs among stakeholders with competing goals.
Working knowledge of lifecycle marketing and growth infrastructure (e.g., an ESP/CDP such as Braze, attribution, CMS).
Strong analytical and experimentation background, with the ability to define north-star and leading-indicator metrics and read them inside a test window.
Demonstrated success in influencing senior stakeholders, including CEO/CFO-level target-setting conversations.
Excellent storytelling communication; able to simplify complexity and inspire action across technical and business audiences.
Experience applying AI tools to improve growth decision-making.
English and Spanish professional proficiency


Diversity & Inclusion

At Kueski we embrace diversity in all forms, systematically promote equity, and ensure everyone feels included with a sense of belonging. We are committed to the full inclusion of all qualified candidates. As part of this commitment, we will make efforts to ensure reasonable accommodations are made during the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please let the Talent Acquisition team know.

title: Cofundador
description:
About the job

Cofundador Técnico — Leviathan Network




Descripción de la empresa




Leviathan Network es una plataforma tecnológica diseñada para que los fundadores puedan presentar, desarrollar y hacer crecer sus startups y productos, documentando públicamente su evolución y conectándose con las personas, organizaciones e instituciones que pueden ayudarles a avanzar.




Leviathan abarca el ciclo completo de las startups, desde la presentación y desarrollo de una idea hasta su evolución, crecimiento y consolidación, integrando dentro de un mismo ecosistema el talento, los colaboradores, clientes, usuarios, capital, conocimiento, oportunidades e instituciones que una startup puede necesitar a lo largo de ese proceso.




La plataforma permite que los fundadores no solamente desarrollen sus startups y productos, sino que también documenten públicamente su evolución, generen un historial de lo que están construyendo y encuentren dentro del ecosistema las conexiones y oportunidades que pueden ayudarles a avanzar.




Descripción del puesto




Como Cofundador Técnico de Leviathan Network, la persona seleccionada tendrá la responsabilidad de liderar la evolución tecnológica de la plataforma, con especial enfoque en su escalabilidad, rendimiento, estabilidad y crecimiento.




Se requiere un perfil Full-Stack, capaz de comprender la plataforma de manera integral, participar en el desarrollo de nuevas funcionalidades y, al mismo tiempo, identificar y resolver los retos técnicos que surjan conforme aumente su alcance y complejidad.




La responsabilidad principal será llevar la tecnología de Leviathan a una siguiente etapa, fortaleciendo su arquitectura, optimizando su funcionamiento y desarrollando las capacidades necesarias para soportar el crecimiento de la plataforma y del ecosistema.




El puesto contempla participación directa en frontend, backend, bases de datos, APIs, autenticación, integraciones, infraestructura, seguridad, rendimiento y escalabilidad.




También tendrá participación en las decisiones relacionadas con la evolución del producto, evaluando necesidades técnicas, definiendo prioridades y determinando las soluciones necesarias para que Leviathan pueda crecer de manera sólida y sostenible.




Tipo de puesto: Cofundador / Socio

Dedicación: Tiempo completo

Modalidad: A definir




Requisitos




- Experiencia sólida en desarrollo Full-Stack.

- Dominio de desarrollo frontend y backend.

- Experiencia con bases de datos relacionales y/o no relacionales.

- Experiencia en diseño y desarrollo de APIs y servicios backend.

- Conocimiento de arquitectura de software y diseño de sistemas.

- Experiencia con autenticación, autorización y seguridad de aplicaciones.

- Experiencia con infraestructura y servicios en la nube.

- Experiencia en despliegues y entornos de producción.

- Capacidad para identificar problemas de rendimiento, arquitectura y escalabilidad.

- Capacidad para diseñar soluciones orientadas al crecimiento de una plataforma tecnológica.

- Capacidad para trabajar sobre una arquitectura existente y llevarla a una mayor escala.

- Pensamiento orientado a producto.

- Capacidad para tomar decisiones técnicas y establecer prioridades.

- Autonomía, iniciativa y alto sentido de responsabilidad.

- Capacidad para analizar problemas complejos y convertirlos en soluciones técnicas.

- Interés en participar en la evolución de una plataforma tecnológica con visión de largo plazo.




Perfil que requiere Leviathan




La posición requiere una persona técnica que quiera escalar y evolucionar, no solamente programar.




Una persona capaz de analizar una plataforma tecnológica, comprender cómo funciona en conjunto, identificar sus puntos de mejora y tomar las decisiones necesarias para aumentar su capacidad, estabilidad, rendimiento y alcance.




Debe tener criterio técnico para determinar qué debe optimizarse, qué debe evolucionar y qué nuevas capacidades deben incorporarse conforme Leviathan avance hacia nuevas etapas.




Será especialmente valorable la experiencia trabajando con plataformas digitales, SaaS, marketplaces, comunidades tecnológicas o productos con múltiples tipos de usuarios e integraciones.




Más que una lista específica de tecnologías, la posición requiere capacidad técnica, criterio, autonomía y disposición para asumir responsabilidad sobre la evolución tecnológica de Leviathan.




Responsabilidades principales




- Liderar la evolución tecnológica de Leviathan Network.

- Escalar la arquitectura y los componentes de la plataforma.

- Optimizar rendimiento, estabilidad y disponibilidad.

- Desarrollar nuevas funcionalidades y capacidades.

- Evolucionar frontend, backend y bases de datos.

- Diseñar y desarrollar APIs e integraciones.

- Fortalecer infraestructura, seguridad y sistemas de autenticación.

- Identificar cuellos de botella y resolver problemas de escalabilidad.

- Preparar la plataforma para el crecimiento de usuarios, startups, productos y operaciones.

- Evaluar e implementar mejoras tecnológicas que aporten valor al producto.

- Participar en decisiones de arquitectura y evolución del producto.

- Establecer criterios técnicos que permitan que la plataforma continúe creciendo de manera sólida.

- Acompañar la evolución tecnológica de Leviathan conforme aumente su alcance.




Lo que ofrece Leviathan




- 10–20% de equity (participación accionaria en Leviathan Network), determinado de acuerdo con la capacidad técnica, experiencia y nivel de responsabilidad que aporte la persona seleccionada.

- Participación como Cofundador Técnico.

- Participación directa en las decisiones relacionadas con la evolución tecnológica y escalabilidad de la plataforma.

- Un papel estratégico en el crecimiento tecnológico de Leviathan Network.

- La oportunidad de participar en la evolución de una plataforma tecnológica enfocada en abarcar el ciclo completo de las startups.




Lo que representa el puesto




Este no es un puesto convencional de desarrollador.




Como Cofundador Técnico, la persona tendrá una participación directa en la evolución de Leviathan y una responsabilidad fundamental sobre su tecnología.




El reto consiste en llevar una plataforma tecnológica en funcionamiento a una siguiente etapa de escala, capacidad y evolución, acompañando el crecimiento de Leviathan y del ecosistema de startups, productos y fundadores que formarán parte de él.




La posición requiere visión técnica, capacidad de ejecución y criterio para tomar las decisiones que permitan que Leviathan pueda crecer tecnológicamente al ritmo de su desarrollo como plataforma.

title: Account Executive - Distribution Solutions
description:
About the job




Sobre CUBBO







Somos CUBBO, una empresa respaldada por venture capital que construye la infraestructura del ecommerce — combinando tecnología y logística para que las marcas escalen el comercio moderno.




Apoyamos a las marcas conectando todo su proceso de pedidos —desde la compra hasta la entrega— a través de tecnología y operaciones.




Nuestra plataforma atiende a cientos de marcas y procesa +1M de pedidos mensuales, entregando con velocidad y consistencia.




Trabajamos desde la Ciudad de México, donde nuestro equipo construye herramientas y capacidades logísticas para el comercio moderno.







Nuestra Visión







Empoderar a las marcas para que ganen libertad, convirtiéndonos en la plataforma presente en cada transacción del comercio moderno.







No estamos aquí solo para competir; estamos aquí para dominar y redefinir el futuro del comercio moderno. Si eres un jugador AAA, CUBBO te ofrece una plataforma sin igual para ser parte de esta transformación.







Nuestra Misión







Ayudamos al comercio moderno a reducir fricción y entregar mejores experiencias de compra. Nuestra plataforma conecta todo el proceso de pedidos —desde la compra hasta la entrega— a través de tecnología, operaciones y logística.







Ubicación







Ciudad de México (Headquarters)




Modelo híbrido: 4 días presencial, 1 día remoto




Sí, no somos 100% remotos.







El Rol




Como Account Executive para Distribution Solutions, no serás simplemente un vendedor; serás el arquitecto que diseña cómo las marcas más importantes de México y el mundo escalan sus operaciones. Tu misión es transformar la complejidad logística en una ventaja competitiva, posicionando a Cubbo como la columna vertebral tecnológica y operativa de las marcas de consumo moderno.




Serás el dueño del ciclo de ventas de principio a fin, identificando oportunidades estratégicas donde nuestras soluciones de distribución e infraestructura puedan desbloquear un crecimiento sin precedentes para nuestros clientes. Tu impacto se medirá en la eficiencia de miles de pedidos y en la consolidación de Cubbo como el líder indiscutible del ecosistema e-commerce en la región.




Buscamos a un closer nato, alguien que se sienta cómodo navegando conversaciones complejas y que comparta nuestra obsesión por redefinir el comercio moderno. Si te apasiona la tecnología, la logística y ganar en un entorno de hiper-crecimiento, este es tu lugar.







Responsabilidades Clave




**Estrategia de Ventas y Prospección**

• Identificar y calificar clientes potenciales de alto valor (marcas regionales y globales) que requieran infraestructura avanzada de distribución.

• Construir y gestionar un pipeline robusto de oportunidades para asegurar el cumplimiento de metas mensuales y trimestrales.

• Desarrollar estrategias de prospección personalizadas que resalten la propuesta de valor única de Cubbo en tecnología y logística.




**Consultoría y Cierre de Negocios**

• Liderar presentaciones y demostraciones técnicas, articulando cómo nuestra infraestructura resuelve problemas críticos de la cadena de suministro.

• Negociar términos comerciales complejos y cerrar acuerdos multianuales que aseguren el crecimiento a largo plazo de la compañía.

• Colaborar con los equipos de Operaciones y Producto para asegurar que las soluciones propuestas sean viables y escalables.




**Gestión de Relaciones y Mercado**

• Actuar como un asesor estratégico para los tomadores de decisiones (C-level), entendiendo profundamente sus necesidades de negocio.

• Analizar tendencias de mercado y competencia para adaptar nuestro discurso de ventas y mantener nuestra ventaja competitiva.

• Mantener una higiene rigurosa del CRM para proporcionar visibilidad precisa sobre el pronóstico de ventas y el comportamiento del mercado.







Habilidades y Competencias




• Mentalidad de Ownership: dueño de sus números y de la experiencia del cliente.

• Resiliencia y persistencia para navegar ciclos de venta largos y entornos startup de alta velocidad.

• Habilidades de comunicación excepcionales y capacidad de persuasión a nivel directivo.

• Orientación absoluta a resultados (Quota Crusher).







Hard Skills




• Experiencia demostrable en ventas B2B de ciclo complejo (Logística, SaaS, o Supply Chain).

• Dominio de metodologías de venta consultiva.

• Manejo avanzado de herramientas CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot o similares) para la gestión de pipeline.

• Capacidad de análisis financiero para construir Business Cases y calcular el ROI para clientes potenciales.

• Inglés profesional fluido (capacidad para negociar con marcas internacionales).







Deseable




• Red de contactos establecida en el sector de Retail o E-commerce en México.

• Experiencia previa en startups de logística, tecnología de rápido crecimiento o retail.

• Conocimiento profundo del ecosistema de e-commerce (marketplaces, plataformas de última milla, etc.).

• Pasión por los retos técnicos y la innovación en procesos comerciales.







Nuestros Valores







Customer First: En CUBBO, el cliente es nuestra estrella norte. Operamos bajo el principio de que la mejor decisión para nuestros clientes es la mejor decisión para nosotros.







Confianza: Confías en tus compañeros Cubbeños, reconociendo que el trabajo en equipo es esencial para nuestro éxito colectivo.







Empoderamiento: En CUBBO, esperar instrucciones no es opción. Eres un catalizador que empodera a otros a tomar la iniciativa y tomar decisiones de impacto.







Growth Mindset: Siempre estás haciendo preguntas, con hambre de mejorar. Si no te da pena lo que hacías hace seis meses, no estás creciendo lo suficientemente rápido.







Velocidad: Las ideas solas no ganan mercados; la ejecución rápida y efectiva sí. Actuamos rápido, nos adaptamos y convertimos planes en resultados.







Candor: La transparencia y el feedback constructivo son la base de nuestra cultura. Valoramos la honestidad orientada al crecimiento personal y profesional.







¿Por qué unirte a CUBBO?







Sé parte de una revolución







Únete a nosotros para establecer estándares disruptivos en la industria y cambiar la cara del ecommerce en Latinoamérica. Estamos revolucionando la región entera a través de la innovación.







Trabaja con los mejores







Acelera tu crecimiento profesional exponencialmente en CUBBO. Un año aquí equivale a una década de experiencia en otro lugar. Si eres un high-performer que busca un equipo de campeones, tu búsqueda termina aquí.







Construido para durar, construido para ganar







No solo sobrevivimos; estamos creciendo. Nuestra salud financiera nos permite enfocarnos en lo que realmente importa: ganar el mercado y asegurar una experiencia al cliente sin igual.




Salario




• MXN 55000 bruto mensual

• Crecimiento profesional: oportunidades aceleradas de aprendizaje y desarrollo en una empresa de rápido crecimiento

• Excelente ambiente laboral: trabaja con un equipo inspirador y divertido en una cultura que valora la colaboración, el crecimiento y la mentalidad customer-first

• Estar en la primera fila transformando toda la industria del Comercio Moderno

• Seguro médico

• 20 días de vacaciones desde el día 1

• Servicio / Comedor en la oficina

About the job

HoopStars | Parent-company Marketing Team Lead

Full-time. Remote from LATAM. Toronto working hours. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.

Build the business. Build the marketing team.

HoopStars is a Toronto-based youth basketball business with recurring customers and technology-enabled operations. We are looking for a hands-on General Manager whose strongest skills are marketing, ecommerce and profitable growth, and who can take responsibility for the whole business.

You will divide your time approximately equally between running HoopStars and building and managing the parent company Community Sports Partners' marketing team across its brands. This is one vacancy advertised across multiple locations. Candidates elsewhere in LATAM are also welcome; apply once using your preferred location listing.

You should understand how to turn advertising into customers, improve conversion, increase repeat purchases and make the numbers work. You will also own budgets, operating performance and the team delivering the customer experience.

What You Will Own


Run HoopStars: Own its business plan, budget, revenue, profitability and cash forecasts. Lead sales and operations, ensuring programmes, coaches, venues and service quality keep pace with demand
Drive digital growth: Improve paid search and social, creative, landing pages, enrollment funnels, pricing, offers, referrals and retention
Build the parent marketing team: Define the structure, recruit specialists, appoint contractors or agencies where useful, and manage priorities and performance across brands
Establish commercial discipline: Connect campaign performance to paying customers, repeat enrollment and contribution profit. Allocate marketing investment using reliable reporting and testing
Stay close to execution: Inspect advertising accounts, diagnose funnel problems and help launch improvements yourself while building a team that can execute consistently


Support and autonomy

The parent provides bookkeeping assistance, HR support, IT and website support, and a local manager covering customer service and day-to-day sales. You will propose budgets and team plans, then make operating decisions within agreed authority. After onboarding, the founder expects a monthly business review, supported by clear weekly reporting and escalation of exceptional issues.

Your first 90 days

Understand the customers, operations and economics. Audit marketing across the brands. Establish reporting, propose the marketing team structure and hiring priorities, launch the first growth tests, and take ownership of normal HoopStars business decisions.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You may have built an ecommerce business, led growth for a consumer brand, run a digital agency with meaningful operating responsibility, or managed a business where digital acquisition was central to its success.


Demonstrated results in paid acquisition, conversion and retention
Commercial responsibility beyond a marketing budget: pricing, margins, staffing, forecasts or business profitability
Experience hiring and managing marketers, creatives, agencies or other specialists
Ability to translate ecommerce methods into a service business with real delivery capacity and customer commitments
Comfort doing practical work while developing people and systems
Strong professional English and effective remote leadership


Experience in youth sports, education, fitness, memberships or multi-location services is useful. Evidence of building a profitable business and an effective team matters most.

How To Apply

Submit your CV through this application form. Describe a business or brand you grew, including spend, results and your personal contribution; a team you built or managed; and a commercial decision that failed and what you changed afterward.

Complete both standard assessments before or shortly after applying, using the same email address as your application. If you have already completed them for Community Sports Partners using that email, indicate this in the form.


Culture Index survey
Criteria GAME assessment - English


Benefits

Compensation commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Remote work from LATAM, with Toronto-hours collaboration. Opportunity to build and lead a business and the parent marketing team, with equity opportunity subject to agreed terms. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.

title: Business Analyst, Pet Services
description:
About the job

The Pet & Vet Services Analyst leads end-to-end analytical initiatives that drive operational efficiency, network expansion, and revenue growth across the enterprise pet and vet services ecosystem—including veterinary hospitals, mobile clinics, grooming, and dog training.




Operating seamlessly across the US and Mexico, this role serves as a strategic analytics partner to cross-functional leadership, bridging clinical data, customer behavior, and location intelligence to guide executive decision-making across physical stores, clinical environments, and digital platforms.




Key Responsibilities




1. Network Expansion & Location Intelligence

Site Selection & Pipeline Management: Own analytical processes for hospital site selection, integrating predictive models, demographic data, and performance scorecards to prioritize and rank candidate locations.

M&A & Business Development: Deliver data-driven insights and valuation metrics to support clinic acquisitions, partner integrations, and executive readouts for real estate committees.




2. Customer Insights & Revenue Optimization

Customer Behavior Analytics: Analyze complex customer datasets to uncover trends in appointment utilization, service frequency, and cross-category attach rates (e.g., Rx diets, wellness plans, retail follow-ups).

Forecasting & Pricing Strategy: Partner with business leaders to build operational and financial forecasts, evaluating pricing structures, promotions, and service bundles to maximize customer lifetime value (LTV) and unit economics.




3. Advanced Analytics & Data Engineering

Data Integration: Extract, clean, and model complex datasets from disparate sources (veterinary management systems/EHR, POS, CRM, and cloud warehouses like Snowflake/BigQuery) using SQL, Python, or R.

Predictive Modeling & Experimentation: Design and deploy statistical models, clustering algorithms, and test-and-learn frameworks; partner with Enterprise Data Science to adapt machine learning models to clinical and service operations.




4. Business Intelligence & Executive Communication

Dashboards & Scorecards: Design, automate, and maintain interactive BI dashboards (Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) tracking core operational KPIs, clinic throughput, and customer satisfaction.

Strategic Storytelling: Translate complex quantitative findings into concise visual reports and executive presentations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.




Qualifications & Experience




Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.

Experience: 2–4 years of experience in business analytics, data science, or strategic consulting (experience in retail, healthcare, veterinary care, or subscription business models preferred).

Technical Skills:

SQL & Data Warehousing: Advanced SQL skills with hands-on experience in cloud environments (Snowflake, BigQuery, AWS, etc.).

Programming & Modeling: Proficiency in Python or R for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and automation.

BI & Visualization: Expertise in Tableau, Power BI, or Looker, along with strong presentation design skills.

Core Competencies:

Strong business acumen with the ability to navigate ambiguous problems and deliver actionable recommendations.

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills across cross-border and multi-disciplinary teams.

Overview

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For

This role is responsible for driving customer satisfaction and operational efficiency by resolving complex, escalated technical issues across our industrial, mobile, and RFID printing portfolios. Utilizing deep hardware and software expertise, the successful candidate will diagnose complex print engine failures, address high-tier calibration challenges, and ensure maximum uptime for critical business environments. Additionally, you will maintain standard-setting response times and proactively contribute to the continuous improvement of the Technical Support Team’s printing diagnostic tools and processes.

Advanced Hardware & Software Troubleshooting


Hardware Maintenance: Expertly diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair print engines, label printers, and mobile printing units to significantly reduce customer downtime.
System Calibration: Configure menus, test sensors, and perform precise printhead adjustments to ensure optimal barcode and RFID readability.
Software Integration: Utilize industry-leading tools, including Zebra Setup Utilities and ZebraDesigner, for seamless device configuration and custom label design.


Customer Success & Escalation Management


Serve as the primary escalation point for resolving highly complex, diverse technical issues that require deep data analysis and critical thinking.
Deliver exceptional technical support to customers via telephone, email, and chat, demonstrating active listening and empathy in high-pressure situations.
Translate highly technical concepts into simple, easy-to-understand terms for both customers and internal management.


Leadership & Process Improvement


Act as a mentor and escalation point to support and guide less experienced agents on the team.
Develop, refine, and improve support processes, tools, and platform developments to enhance the overall customer experience.
Analyze data and prepare detailed reports on the effectiveness and efficiency of the support center.
Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors, internal technical teams, business leaders, and technology partners.

Education: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent vocational qualification/experience in a related technical field.
Experience: 4 to 5 years of proven experience in technical support, with a strong emphasis on hardware maintenance (printing devices, RFID, and mobile technology highly preferred).

Strong customer service orientation with a dedication to resolving issues effectively.
Solid professional work behaviors (attendance, teamwork, time management).
Advanced problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate moderately complex factors.
Intermediate to advanced skills in task delegation and follow-up.

Why Join Us?

We offer a collaborative environment where your technical expertise is valued, and your career growth is supported. Help us keep the world's supply chains, hospitals, and retail floors running smoothly.

Benefits

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

Job Posting Statement

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.

AI Technology Statement

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. description:
About the job

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About The Role

We are seeking a Product Marketing Associate to join a small, hands-on Product Marketing team that owns growth strategy and go-to-market execution across Sezzle’s shopper-facing product ecosystem, spanning financial products to engagement and rewards. The team is lean by design: every product marketer owns a real portfolio from day one, works directly with the data, and partners daily with Product, Data, Design, and Marketing Communications to turn research into shipped, measurable growth.

Overall category strategy is set in partnership with the Head of Product Marketing; you’ll own how that strategy comes to life for each individual product in your portfolio, from discovery through launch, optimization, and iteration. This role is well-suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, values structured thinking, and is excited to take ownership of meaningful product initiatives. While this role is aligned to a defined group of products, prioritization is driven by company-level goals and key performance metrics, not equal attention across every surface. You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to continuously assess where Product Marketing efforts will have the greatest impact and dynamically allocate time and resources accordingly — meaning some products or initiatives may require deeper focus at different points in time.

The salary range for this role is $2.000 - $2.900 per month (Gross in USD)

What You’ll Do

Insight Generation & Research


Partner in conducting user research (surveys, user testing, etc,) and own the analysis, turning results into clear, actionable insight
Analyze qualitative and quantitative user data to surface patterns, friction points, and opportunities across your product portfolio within Earn and rewards
Bring a genuine Gen Z consumer perspective to how we frame problems, develop messaging, and evaluate product experiences
Use AI tools to accelerate insight generation and sharpen the inputs that shape growth strategy and marketing plans


Strategy & Execution


Own product marketing for your assigned products, both new and existing, supporting the full lifecycle: Discover & Validate, Shape & Plan, Launch & Learn, Optimize & Scale
Translate overall Earn and rewards category strategy into product-specific positioning and messaging, grounded in behavioral data and user research
Develop and execute GTM plans across in-app surfaces, lifecycle messaging, and marketing channels
Monitor adoption and engagement post-launch, flagging risks and identifying iteration opportunities
Treat everything as a test. Whether you're launching something new or optimizing something existing, you should always be designing for learning, monitoring results, and iterating based on what the data tells you


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Work closely with Product Managers and Marketing Communications on every product you touch. These are your primary partners for testing, launching, and improving
Navigate across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Data, Design, and Marketing to move work forward
Adapt priorities quickly as business needs shift 
Contribute to team documentation so insights and learnings can be shared across teams


Qualifications

Required


1–2 years of experience in Product Marketing, Growth, Consumer Research, or a related field.
Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with qualitative feedback, behavioral data, and survey results
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
Clear, concise communicator who can turn complexity into a sharp insight or recommendation
Curious about AI tools and eager to use them to work smarter. Bonus if you're already using them regularly


Nice to Have


Consumer-facing or mobile product experience
Familiarity with user research methodologies, NPS analysis, or customer interview programs
Experience with lifecycle messaging, in-product copy, or Braze (or similar)
Background in fintech, subscriptions, or marketplace businesses


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

description:
About the job

City : Guadalajara State : México (MX-MEX) Country : Mexico (MX) Requisition Number: 48503

Bunge has an exciting opportunity available for Merchandiser. In this role you will be part of a global team working on challenging, meaningful projects impacting core business activities.  Since 1818, Bunge has been connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world.  Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster and simpler way.  Bunge is committed to operating and thriving in the digital world – creating world class agile teams where teammates are empowered and encouraged to collaborate and test and learn to succeed.

At Bunge, people don’t just come here to work, they come here to grow – solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse team of thinkers and doers. Bunge offers a strong compensation and benefits package, generous paid time off program, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity to progress.  Our hybrid work environment provides a balance of in-office and remote work. Most importantly, in all we do we live our values:


 Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect
 Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative and efficient
 Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably


A Day in the Life:

Develop the origination, marketing, and execution of commodities within a designated geographic area and/or assigned customer portfolio. The key objective of this role is to drive sales and market growth, strengthen arbitrage and risk management capabilities, and achieve or exceed profitability targets. This is accomplished through close interaction with customers and suppliers, delivering excellent service and support, and expanding the customer/supplier base with a strong focus on improving margins and overall profitability.

What You'll Be Doing:

Actively participate in the research, analysis, and execution of commodity market strategies for customer trading.

Maintain constant communication with customers and suppliers to address their needs, ensure excellent service, improve logistical efficiency, and increase business margins.

Provide follow-up and guidance to the Merchandiser Trainee programs.

Support and oversee the implementation of origination programs relevant to the area.

Execute and manage the development of a P&L (profit and loss) for the assigned area.

Record sales, operations, and general information in internal databases.

Prepare weekly and monthly profit and loss estimates.

Build operational knowledge in fixed price and margin risk management.

Buy and sell assigned products to/from specific customers, delivering high-quality market analysis and commercial recommendations.

Oversee logistics programs, including load review, rates, and cost tracking.

Develop impactful ideas and strategic projects that contribute significantly to the business

Support the development of new markets and continuous process improvement.

Collaborate closely with other teams to achieve shared goals.

Perform other activities inherent to the department

Skills/Experience

3+ years of experience in the industry, in roles such as Trader or Merchandiser.

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Engineering, Business Administration, International Business, or a related field.

Collaborate, effectively communicate with others and take initiative to continually develop themselves.

Pursue opportunities to solve problems and take action while maintaining the ability to manage work, even in times of challenge or change.

Knowledge of international trade

Strong numerical skills

Understanding of the futures market

Experience in pricing and contract management

Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously, with a strong sense of urgency and within tight deadlines

Proactive mindset

Decision-making skills

Excellent communication skills

Intermediate to advanced Excel proficiency

Advanced English proficiency

Valid visa

Outgoing and confident attitude

Customer service orientation

Sales-driven mindset

Attention to detail

Leadership and strategic thinking

At Bunge (NYSE: BG), our purpose is to connect farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed and fuel to the world. As a premier agribusiness solutions provider, our team of :34,000 dedicated employees partner with farmers across the globe to move agricultural commodities from where they’re grown to where they’re needed—in faster, smarter, and more efficient ways. We are a world leader in grain origination, storage, distribution, oilseed processing and refining, offering a broad portfolio of plant-based oils, fats, and proteins. We work alongside our customers at both ends of the value chain to deliver quality products and develop tailored, innovative solutions that address evolving consumer needs. With 200+ years of experience and presence in over 50 countries, we are committed to strengthening global food security, advancing sustainability, and helping communities prosper where we operate. Bunge has its registered office in Geneva, Switzerland and its corporate headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri. Learn more at Bunge.com.

Every day our people exemplify these values, which represent Bunge at its core:


 We Are One Team – Collaborative, Respectful, Inclusive 
 We Lead The Way – Agile, Empowered, Innovative 
 We Do What’s Right – Safety, Sustainability, With Integrity 


If this sounds like you, join us! We value and invest in people who believe in our purpose and are excited to live it every day – people who are #ProudtoBeBunge

description:
About the job

Description

Amazon Advertising operates at the intersection of eCommerce and advertising, offering a rich array of advertising solutions. We partner with advertisers to reach Amazon customers on Amazon.com, across our other owned and operated sites, on other high quality sites across the web, and on millions of devices. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing organization working to build a unique, world-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.

We’re looking for a results oriented Sales Account Manager who is passionate about partnering with our advertisers, educating them and helping to solve ambiguous business problems, mitigating risks before they become roadblocks. As a Sales Account Manager, you manage and deliver against complex advertiser goals and problems to drive revenue and achieve revenue targets. You nurture customer relationships and create revenue opportunities from the advertisers you own. You’ll not only dive deep into data to understand trends, but also communicate the “why” behind results and make actionable recommendations to internal and external stakeholders. Additionally, you’ll be able to leverage Amazon’s proprietary data to provide strategic and personalized recommendations, influencing both your internal team and your external customer to facilitate them reaching their business goals. This role is highly collaborative, working with Creative, Senior Sales, Product, and Retail partners and will drive process improvement to gain efficiency and foster collaboration. The Senior Account Manager’s strategic digital expertise and influence is considered critical to unlocking greater value and impact for our advertisers.

Key job responsibilities


 Become a knowledgeable partner and leader on Amazon Advertising solutions
 Deliver the highest level of sales and customer service to our clients.
 Retain and grow revenue from existing advertisers.
 Drive deals to closure in a new business environment.
 Develop annual media strategies for growth based on overall advertiser goals and objectives
 Develop campaign strategies and audience engagement recommendations
 Evaluate success metrics and drive campaign performance using data
 Perform in-depth data analysis to form and deliver actionable recommendations for both short- and long-term advertising strategy
 Educate advertisers on performance metrics, insights, and how to drive greater results
 Work cross-functionally with Senior Sales and other Amazon partners to drive incremental revenue and increase advertiser satisfaction


Basic Qualifications


 Experience in programmatic strategy and implementation
 3+ years of client-facing role including, but not limited to, digital marketing, analytics, or equivalent experience
 Experience in omni-channel marketing, search engine marketing or search engine optimization
 Experience in a customer-facing role, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies
 Experience in process improvement


Preferred Qualifications


 Bachelor's degree in Economics, Marketing, Advertising, Statistics, Engineering, or Business
 Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
 Experience in the advertising, media or agency landscape, and proven track record of reaching and exceeding sales revenue goals via new and existing business

About the job

About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About The Role

Happyrobot is looking for a highly organized and execution-driven Field Marketing Specialist to join our rapidly growing LATAM Field Marketing team. In this role, you will be responsible for planning and executing our LATAM conference strategy and initiatives that connect directly with customers and prospects to drive pipeline.

This role will largely be focused on third-party industry trade shows and conferences in LatAm, mainly in Brazil and Mexico. As we build out a robust field marketing engine, you will collaborate with our events team and work closely with our Content and Creative team to ensure our booth experiences and event collateral are top-tier.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love the logistics of a great event, we want to hear from you!

What You’ll Do


Manage all trade show and conference deadlines, coordinate booth materials, and oversee shipping/freight logistics.
Organize, prep, and manage on-site schedules for the sales team and attending executives to maximize their time and impact.
Research, evaluate, and recommend the best industry conferences and trade shows across our target verticals.
Secure, handle, and optimize event sponsorships and executive presentation/speaking opportunities.
Ensure seamless lead capture at events and partner with revenue teams to track pipeline impact.


Must Have


Minimum of 2 years of dedicated field marketing and event management expertise.
Hands-on experience working with major trade show vendors and general contractors.
Strong experience using Salesforce for lead capture, list imports, and campaign tracking.
Basic ability to navigate Figma to collaborate efficiently with our creative and design teams on booth graphics and collateral.
Ability to hit the ground running immediately and handle high event volumes.


Nice-to-have


English, Spanish & Portuguese languages Proficiency. 


Why join us?


Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.
Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.


Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

title: Growth Marketing Manager (Lifecycle Lead)

Drive the integration between the CRM platform and behavioral analytics tools (e.g., Amplitude, Segment, or equivalent) for real-time audience activation — building dynamic, event-triggered flows, not just pulling reports.

Implement proper measurement infrastructure: conversion tracking tied to business outcomes (loans disbursed, activations, repayments) and control group methodology to measure true incrementality — not just opens and clicks.

Design customer journeys powered by dynamic data and database logic — replacing manually-configured, hardcoded flows with scalable, automated systems that minimize operational risk and manual error exposure.

Own lifecycle KPIs and dashboards; communicate insights with a clear point of view and strategic recommendations, not just raw metrics.
Partner with Product, Data Engineering, and Data Science to improve event tracking, integrate predictive models (churn, upsell), and align lifecycle programs with the product experience.
Run A/B and multivariate experiments across channels, content, and timing to continuously improve engagement and downstream conversion.

4+ years in lifecycle marketing or CRM, with at least 2 years in a strategic not purely operational capacity within a major CRM/marketing automation platform (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, Iterable, Klaviyo, or equivalent).
Proven experience integrating CRM platforms with analytics or CDP tools for real-time audience activation, not only reporting.
Experience designing scalable, data-driven lifecycle architectures: dynamic content, event-triggered journeys, and database-powered flows — not manually-configured logic trees.
Ability to activate advanced platform capabilities: real-time personalization APIs, in-app messaging, conversion tracking, and control group measurement.
Track record of diagnosing and remediating platform health issues — segment bloat, attribute sprawl, naming inconsistency — and implementing governance that prevents recurrence.
Strong analytical skills: able to interpret behavioral data, identify conversion drop-off points, and translate findings into lifecycle strategy.
Solid understanding of email deliverability, mobile push best practices, and omnichannel communication principles.
Strong bias toward automation, system design, and scalability over manual, campaign-by-campaign execution.
description:
About the job

About Kueski

At Kueski, we're dedicated to improving the financial lives of people in Mexico. Since 2012, we've been the leading buy now, pay later (BNPL) and online consumer credit platform in Latin America, known for our innovative financial services. Our flagship product, Kueski Pay, provides seamless payment solutions for both online and in-store transactions, establishing itself as the preferred option for nearly 30% of Mexico's top e-commerce merchants. Notably, we were the first to introduce BNPL on Amazon Mexico.

We're a tech company with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration, and impact, fostering a strong, diverse, and inclusive workplace. Our commitment to excellence and ethical business practices has earned us multiple industry recognitions. In 2024, we were named one of the World’s Top FinTech Companies by CNBC and recognized as one of the most ethical companies

in Mexico by AMITAI. Additionally, we were certified as a Best Place to Work for LGBTQ+ Equality by HRC Equidad MX 2025 and ranked among the Best Companies for Female Talent by EFY.

Position

Kueski is seeking a Growth Marketing Manager for a strategic lifecycle marketer who can take Kueski's CRM to the next level not by sending more, but by sending smarter. You'll own how we engage customers across email, push, SMS, WhatsApp, in-app, and web, with full ownership of the MarTech stack that enables lifecycle execution. This role requires someone who thinks in systems: data-driven journeys, scalable automation, and deep integration between tools and business outcomes. If you're an expert who's frustrated by platforms operating well below their potential and you know how to change that this is your role.

Key Responsabilities

MarTech Strategy & Stack Architecture


Own the lifecycle MarTech stack end-to-end: not just campaign execution, but how platforms are configured, integrated, and evolved to support scalable growth.
Drive the integration between the CRM platform and behavioral analytics tools (e.g., Amplitude, Segment, or equivalent) for real-time audience activation — building dynamic, event-triggered flows, not just pulling reports.
Enable advanced personalization capabilities: real-time API-driven content, in-app and web messaging, and dynamic content powered by live data.
Implement proper measurement infrastructure: conversion tracking tied to business outcomes (loans disbursed, activations, repayments) and control group methodology to measure true incrementality — not just opens and clicks.
Set up user-level preference management to reduce opt-out risk and respect communication preferences at scale.


Lifecycle Architecture & Automation


Design customer journeys powered by dynamic data and database logic — replacing manually-configured, hardcoded flows with scalable, automated systems that minimize operational risk and manual error exposure.
Build a reusable library of journey templates, segmentation frameworks, and content modules that reduce setup time across campaigns.
Define and own the lifecycle strategy across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and win-back stages, with clear KPIs at each stage.


Platform Governance & Operational Health


Audit and restructure the current CRM environment: standardize segment architecture, establish naming conventions, and clean up attribute and tag sprawl accumulated over time.
Eliminate dependency on manual data imports by transitioning to event-triggered, API-based audience activation.
Establish governance standards for how campaigns, journeys, and segments are built and maintained — ensuring the platform scales without accumulating technical debt.


Performance & Cross-Functional Collaboration


Own lifecycle KPIs and dashboards; communicate insights with a clear point of view and strategic recommendations, not just raw metrics.
Partner with Product, Data Engineering, and Data Science to improve event tracking, integrate predictive models (churn, upsell), and align lifecycle programs with the product experience.
Run A/B and multivariate experiments across channels, content, and timing to continuously improve engagement and downstream conversion.

4+ years in lifecycle marketing or CRM, with at least 2 years in a strategic not purely operational capacity within a major CRM/marketing automation platform (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, Iterable, Klaviyo, or equivalent).
Proven experience integrating CRM platforms with analytics or CDP tools for real-time audience activation, not only reporting.
Experience designing scalable, data-driven lifecycle architectures: dynamic content, event-triggered journeys, and database-powered flows — not manually-configured logic trees.
Ability to activate advanced platform capabilities: real-time personalization APIs, in-app messaging, conversion tracking, and control group measurement.
Track record of diagnosing and remediating platform health issues — segment bloat, attribute sprawl, naming inconsistency — and implementing governance that prevents recurrence.
Strong analytical skills: able to interpret behavioral data, identify conversion drop-off points, and translate findings into lifecycle strategy.
Solid understanding of email deliverability, mobile push best practices, and omnichannel communication principles.
Strong bias toward automation, system design, and scalability over manual, campaign-by-campaign execution.

title: Spanish to English Interpreter
description:
About the job

We’re actively #hiring! Know someone who might be interested?

We are currently hiring Spanish to English Medical Interpreters for a fully remote, full-time Independent Contractor opportunity with i-Call International. The role involves facilitating clear, accurate communication between Spanish-speaking patients and healthcare providers, including doctors, nurses, and other medical professionals.

The selected interpreters will be responsible for accurately interpreting medical terminology, diagnoses, treatments, and healthcare-related information between Spanish and English. The role also involves providing cultural mediation when required, maintaining strict patient confidentiality and professional ethical standards, documenting interpretation services, and staying current with medical terminology and healthcare practices. Candidates will provide both Over-the-Phone Interpretation (OPI) and Video Remote Interpretation (VRI) services.

Candidates must be fluent in Spanish and English, with experience in medical interpretation or translation preferred. Strong knowledge of medical terminology, familiarity with healthcare-related conversations, excellent communication skills, cultural sensitivity, and the ability to work accurately under pressure are essential.

This is a remote position paying $5 per hour, with additional attendance and QA bonuses. Work will follow an hourly shift schedule aligned with the EST time zone, and payments will be made monthly through Payoneer.

Candidates must have a quiet, professional workspace, a minimum 15 Mbps download and upload internet connection, a compulsory USB headset, a PC or laptop with at least a 5th-generation processor and 8GB RAM, LAN/Ethernet connectivity, and an HD webcam.

After accepting the offer, selected candidates will complete a mandatory 80-hour training program over 10 business days. Training is paid at half of the agreed hourly rate, subject to successfully passing the assessment and starting employment. The final assessment will be conducted through LanguageStat, and successful candidates will receive client portal credentials and technical guidance.

Country Eligibility: The client does not accept applicants from the following countries/regions:

European Countries: Albania, Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Moldova, the Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, the United States, Canada, Bolivia.

description:
About the job

Senior Data Analyst Job Description:




GENERAL SUMMARY




The Information Management Team at RGA utilizes best practice design techniques to deliver analytical platforms, data management, and business intelligence solutions that meet business needs. We work closely with business teams to translate their requirements into technology solutions, empower them to work more efficiently and deliver a superior service to our customers.

The Senior Data Analyst is the primary liaison between international business stakeholders and an IT data warehousing team. This person is responsible for analyzing structured business data and facilitating the understanding of business requirements for data transformation and reporting solutions. The ideal candidate is fluent in SQL, data profiling, experienced in data warehouse project delivery, and knowledgeable of data warehousing best practices. Participates in global projects through the entire life of the project and can evaluate business requests to determine requirements, feasibility, and recommend business solutions.




PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Works with project teams to support requirements gathering including
Analyzes structured data sources in support of integration into data warehouse environments
Facilitates the definition of business rules to transform and conform data with Subject Matter Experts
Facilitates the definition and prototyping of business requirements for reporting
Analyzes source system and reporting data repositories to assess data quality and makes recommendations for improving data quality
Works with the business to identify data issues and identify potential solutions
Proactively identifies ways to measure and improve data quality through business rules and automation
Develops and documents business requirements and facilitates structured walkthroughs of requirements with business and project team members
Implements process improvements; recommends enhancements that result in increased quality and service
Evaluates business requests to determine feasibility; researches and identifies options
Encourages collaboration and assists in the development of a shared understanding of evolving requirements and project needs
Participates in project planning, sprint planning, change management, Q&A testing, troubleshooting, and incident response activities
Maintains regular and predictable attendance
Performs other duties as assigned




JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Education and Experience

Required:

Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of work experience, of which 2+ years of project delivery experience as a Data Analyst or Technical Business Analyst
Extensive knowledge of Data Warehousing processes and best practices
Experience creating user stories

Preferred:

Experience with reporting tools like Tableau or Business Objects
Experience with Erwin data modelling tool
Six Sigma Certification
Insurance industry experience




Skills and Abilities

Required:

Advanced data analysis and SQL skills
Ability to work well within an agile team environment and facilitate team conversations
Strong interpersonal skills, demonstrating an ability to work with others across a wide variety of operational, functional, and technical disciplines
Detail orientation and ability to deliver a high level of accuracy
Ability to set goals, and handle multiple tasks, clients, and projects simultaneously
Advanced ability to translate business needs and problems into viable/accepted solutions
Advanced investigative, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Ability to quickly adapt to new methods, work under tight deadlines and stressful conditions
Strong oral and written communication skills, demonstrating ability to share and impart knowledge
Ability to appropriately balance priorities, deadlines, and deliverables while working through ambiguity




WORKING AT RGA

At the forefront of RGA’s culture is collaboration. It’s the one thing every contractor and employee must embrace to succeed. RGA’s culture also is defined by an environment where intellectual thinking, not red tape, is prioritized. RGA believes risk is not to be avoided but smartly embraced.

Responsable del diseño, desarrollo y evolución de servicios backend para sistemas de alto volumen y alta disponibilidad. Participarás activamente en la definición de arquitectura, diseño de APIs, modelado de datos y comunicación entre servicios mediante REST, RabbitMQ y/o Kafka.

Tendrás responsabilidad técnica sobre decisiones relacionadas con microservicios, persistencia de datos, escalabilidad, observabilidad, resiliencia y estrategias de despliegue en nube (AWS).

Colaborarás en el diagnóstico y resolución de incidentes de producción mediante análisis de logs, métricas, trazas y análisis de causa raíz, proponiendo mejoras que reduzcan fallos recurrentes y aumenten la estabilidad de la plataforma.




Experiencia participando en code reviews, definición de estándares de desarrollo, buenas prácticas de ingeniería y mentoría de desarrolladores con menor experiencia.




El perfil debe contar con experiencia sólida de 7 años en al menos uno de los siguientes lenguajes: Python, Java, .NET/C# o Go; experiencia práctica con Docker y arquitecturas basadas en microservicios; así como conocimiento de PostgreSQL, MongoDB y Redis.




Se valorará experiencia en Start Ups, en diseño de sistemas distribuidos, patrones de arquitectura, CI/CD, observabilidad, pruebas automatizadas, seguridad de APIs y despliegues en entornos cloud.
